meta.name_zh: 癌症登記檔短表 SF(2007-2010年)
meta.data_description_zh: 收錄各醫院申報 2007-2010年診斷個案之原始資料。
meta.notes_zh:
1. ※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身
分證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日
期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜
出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 收錄各醫院申報 2007-2010 年診斷個案之原始資料，並未進行院際間相同個案同
一癌症同一組織型態分組之重複個案去除。
3. 癌症登記短表所包含之癌症別，除短表醫院申報的所有癌症外，還包含長表醫院
申報之外其他所有癌別，均以短表申報。
4. 如需分析自 1979年診斷至最新發表年度，且已去除院際重複之年報歸戶資料，請
申請年報歸戶檔。 1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health15_癌症登記檔短表SF(2010年以前版本)
meta.data_description_en: records of diagnostic cases reported by various hospitals from 2007 to 2010.
meta.notes_en: 1. See the NHI guidelines for applying for a catastrophic-illness certificate for rare diseases. 2. Rare-disease reporting flow (facilities, HPA): (i) Under Article 7 of the Rare Disease and Orphan Drug Act, medical personnel who discover a patient with a rare disease, or a death caused by one, must report to the central competent authority (the Department of Health's Health Promotion Administration). (ii) When a physician diagnoses an insured person with a rare disease, per the above they enter the case into the Rare Disease Integrated Information Management System and report to the HPA. (iii) The HPA accepts the report and, after expert-committee review, records the result in the rare-disease database (results: approved, not approved, under review; review takes about 10 working days); the HPA notifies the reporting hospital and copies the NHIA. 3. Rare-disease definition is limited to confirmed cases per the MOHW-announced rare diseases (main diagnosis code, Chinese/English disease name, rare-disease serial number) recorded in the database. 4. Data years 2012-2022/02.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health15_癌症登記檔短表SF(2011-2017年版本)
meta.data_description_en: Includes original data of diagnosed cases reported by each hospital from 2011 to 2017.
meta.notes_en:
1. ※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
2. Contains the raw data as reported by each hospital for cases diagnosed from 2011-2017 onward; duplicate-case removal across hospitals for the same case, same cancer, and same histological type grouping has not been performed.
3. The cancer types covered by the short-form cancer registry (2011/ROC year 100 edition) include, in addition to all cancers reported by short-form hospitals, all other cancer types not reported by long-form hospitals, all reported via the short form.
4. For cases classified as 0 or 3, field items 7.1-7.5 do not need to be reported and are filled with 9.
5. If you need to analyze data from diagnosis year 1979 through the most recently published year, with inter-hospital duplicates already removed and consolidated into an annual-report roll-up, please apply for the Annual Report Roll-up File.
1. The ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. The key for linking records to an individual and matching individual data: ID.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health15_癌症登記檔短表SF(2018年以後版本)
meta.data_description_en: Cancer cases newly diagnosed since 2018, except for those reported on long forms, are now submitted using the 2018 cancer registration short form items. (Some data may include pre-2017 diagnosis year supplementary reports.)
meta.notes_en: For MRI or PET, because the NHI card is checked during admission and then returned, the insured person cannot obtain the card. Notes: (1) If the anomaly occurs before the visit sequence number is obtained from the card, so the NHI IC card cannot be read/written, use the anomaly code in the 'visit sequence number not yet obtained' field as the visit sequence number for that record. (2) If the anomaly occurs after the sequence number was obtained, so the card can no longer be read/written, use the anomaly code in the 'visit sequence number obtained' field. (3) For a 'not yet obtained' anomaly code, when the cardholder updates the anomaly data at an update machine, their 'most recent visit sequence number' (visit types 01-08) and the sum of all fees and counts are updated. (4) For an 'obtained' anomaly code, only the sum of all fees and counts is updated. (5) A facility that, after NHIA regional-division guidance, genuinely cannot implement NHI IC card network connection and cannot accept IC-card visits may apply on a case basis and, with approval, report using H000.
